info.title: Beacon AR API
info.description: Delegated Microsoft Entra user access tokens (v2) only. Explicit idtyp must be user; without idtyp, delegated scp is required and roles-only client-credentials tokens are rejected. business.write implies business.read.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Trimmed, case-insensitive free-text search.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: One-based page number. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100.
